test_ism_variants: test ism_variants generates all single nucleotide variants for a genomic interval and sequence
test_ism_variants_skip_n: test ism_variants with skip_n flag to skip N bases in the sequence
test_ism_matrix: test ism_matrix constructs a position base matrix from variant scores and variants
test_ism_matrix_subset: test ism_matrix with an interval subset to filter variants within a genomic range
test_ism_matrix_missing_variants: test ism_matrix raises ValueError for out of bounds interval or use require_fully_filled
